mapLabel: Hiel Drive, from the 1974 sheet and a 1951 house
note: Hiel Drive is added from the 1974 Bushnell West quadrangle and a 1951 year-built record. Lakelawn Estate is not on a map found for 1960, so those streets stay off until 1970.

streets.name: Hiel Drive
streets.notes: Hiel Drive, the loop at the north end of West Main. Spelled Hiel, not Heil. The 1974 Bushnell West quadrangle draws the loop. The 1918 Good Hope sheet does not. County year-built records list a house at 10 Hiel Drive in 1951, so the street is shown from the 1960 stop. Individual house symbols along the loop were not separated from the built-up tint, so no houses were copied from that sheet. Centerline from OpenStreetMap. The width is not printed.
